name: localization-check
description: Flags hardcoded user-facing strings and missing translation keys in this repo's locale JSON files

localizationCheck.scriptPath.description: Path to check-localization.js, relative to the workspace root.

localizationCheck.liveScan.description: Underline hardcoded strings live as you edit .ts/.tsx/.js/.jsx files (in addition to the git-staged check run via the command).

localizationCheck.warnOnStage.description: Show a warning notification when files staged for commit contain hardcoded text that isn't localized. This is a heads-up only — it does not block the commit itself; use the pre-commit hook for that.
